high_level_description: This image depicts a cozy and well-decorated living room. The room features a wooden furniture set that includes a sofa, two armchairs, and a coffee table. The furniture is made of polished wood with a warm, honey-colored finish, giving the space a rustic yet elegant look. The sofa and armchairs are upholstered with light beige cushions, and each piece has decorative throw pillows in various patterns, including zigzag designs in shades of orange, yellow, and white. The coffee table in front of the sofa is also made of wood and has a simple, rectangular shape with rounded edges.
